# Permissions

The **162 permissions** of SupMod, generated from the `plugin.yml` of the plugin. The "Default" column tells who has it without a permission plugin: <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span>, operators through <span class="who staff">Staff</span> (`supmod.staff`) or <span class="who admin">Admin</span> (`supmod.admin`), or <span class="who nobody">Nobody</span> (give it yourself).

::: tip
Search a permission with the site search (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd>). The [Permissions and ranks](/guide/permissions) guide has a LuckPerms setup ready to copy.
:::

## Permission groups {#groups}

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `supmod.*` | <span class="who admin">Operators</span> | Same as supmod.admin (does not add supmod.admin.commands nor the exempt and bypass permissions) |
| `supmod.staff` | <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | All staff permissions (moderators) |
| `supmod.admin` | <span class="who admin">Admin</span> | All SupMod permissions |

| `supmod.verification.bypass` | <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Never asked to pass the join verification |
| `supmod.verification.manage` | <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Mark a player as verified or reset his verification (/sm verify) |

| `supmod.security.bypass-ip-limit` | <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Not limited by security.max-accounts-per-ip (maximum accounts per IP) |
| `supmod.itemsearch` | <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Search an item in the inventories and ender chests of the online players, scan the suspicious amounts (/sm itemsearch) |
